summary: Liberty Defense Holdings filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 2, 2026 press release announcing that Cleveland Hopkins International Airport will deploy two HEXWAVE walkthrough screening systems for its Aviation Worker Screening program. Wadsworth Solutions serves as prime contractor for installation, training, and support. No transaction, securities offering, or corporate action is disclosed; the event is an ordinary commercial product deployment, bringing HEXWAVE installations to nine airports. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are stated. Risk-arb angle: none; this is routine operational news, not a special situation.
